01:10 第一章　任期中間的一場大考
02:18 第二章　三權分立和兩院
06:15 第三章　拿到煞車，不是方向盤
08:06 第四章　誰在背後砸錢
11:03 第五章　三種結果，三種劇本
13:01 第六章　十九次期中選舉
14:13 第七章　真正握著方向盤的東西
15:19 結尾：開票之後盯三件事

本影片僅供資訊參考，不構成投資建議。片中歷史統計為言究院依 Yahoo Finance 標普 500 每日收盤自行計算（價格指數，不含股息）。川普原聲片段來自白宮公開影像（2026.1.6 共和黨眾議員會議、2026.10.23 白宮南草坪，經 Global News Beacon 轉載）；Talarico 發言依 MS NOW 報導的引文呈現。

snippet.title: రాప్తాడు రాక్షసుడికి కాలు తొలగించిన వైద్యులు | మంచి శిక్ష పడిందంటూ ఊరిలో సంబరాలు! #RaptaduIncident
snippet.description:
The accused, Hemanth, who attacked a schoolgirl in Raptadu, has suffered a life-altering consequence. Doctors at Anantapur Government Hospital performed surgery and amputated his right leg above the knee. As a result, he is likely to live with a permanent physical disability for the rest of his life. During the police encounter, bullets struck both his legs, causing severe blood loss and completely damaging the blood vessels in his right leg. As blood circulation to the lower part of the leg stopped, the tissue began to deteriorate, creating a life-threatening situation. To save his life, doctors had no choice but to amputate his right leg during surgery on Monday night. Hospital Superintendent Mallishwari confirmed this. Doctors also performed surgery on the severely damaged blood vessels in his left leg. The horrific incident took place on October 31 at the Raptadu Zilla Parishad High School. Hemanth, a 21-year-old relative of the victim, Gopika, had reportedly been harassing her for some time, pressuring her to accept his love. When Gopika's parents reprimanded him and she herself rejected his advances, he developed a grudge against her. Following a carefully planned attack, he entered a school classroom carrying an electric saw and brutally attacked Gopika. He also injured another girl who tried to intervene, cutting her leg. After the attack, Hemanth escaped into the Atmakur forest area. When the police arrived to catch him, he attacked them with a knife. In response, the police opened fire at his legs in self-defence and took him into custody. Following the news of his amputation, people in the village have reportedly expressed relief and celebrated what they see as justice being served. Many believe that living with a permanent disability for the rest of his life is a punishment worse than death. They are also praising the coalition government, saying it has stood by the victim and ensured justice for her. People are recalling Nara Lokesh's earlier warning that anyone who harasses or attacks a girl will face serious consequences, saying the government has now demonstrated that commitment through action. They believe such strict action will create fear among criminals and discourage future attacks against women and girls. Meanwhile, the coalition government has extended complete support to the injured student, Gopika. Apart from providing her with advanced medical treatment, the government has taken responsibility for supporting her family in every possible way. Gopika is currently undergoing treatment in the hospital and is slowly recovering. Nara Lokesh has assured the family that the government will bear the entire medical expenditure, which is expected to exceed ₹1 crore. When we look at this incident, one thing becomes clear: Hemanth's thoughtless and violent decision, driven by the attitude that if he could not have Gopika, nobody else should, has completely changed two lives. Today, Gopika is fighting for her life in the hospital, while Hemanth faces the prospect of living with a permanent disability after losing his right leg. In just two days, two lives have taken completely different turns. Therefore, before engaging in such attacks or harassing women, every individual must think about the consequences. One moment of restraint could prevent two lives and entire families from being destroyed. Those who think of harming women should remember the consequences Hemanth is now facing.

• 디스크 환자 절대 주의: 허리와 골반의 회전(비틀기)이 크게 일어나는 동작이므로, 허리 디스크(요추 추간판 탈출증)가 있거나 다리 저림·방사통이 있으신 분은 절대 따라 하지 마세요.
• 반동 및 어깨 들림 주의: 다리를 넘기거나 무릎을 누를 때 욕심내어 반동을 주지 마시고, 반대쪽 어깨가 바닥에서 과하게 뜨지 않도록 고정한 상태에서 시원한 범위까지만 천천히 진행해 주세요.

snippet.title: Nigel Farage SLAMS Labour migration U-turn as 'BETRAYAL' in fiery speech
snippet.description:
Nigel Farage has slammed Britain's mass immigration crisis as a "betrayal" of the will of the British people.

Speaking at a press conference following Home Secretary Shabana Mahmood announcing a U-turn on indefinite leave to remain, the Reform UK leader suggested that those who had voted to leave the EU had done so to clamp down on immigration.

Home Secretary Shabana Mahmood confirmed care workers will be able to apply for indefinite leave to remain after five years – ten years before Ms Mahmood’s original proposals – if they’ve earned £25,000-per-year in the sector.

Those who miss out on Labour’s generous scheme will “be offered a second chance to contribute through a new five-year visa”. Around 300,000 will benefit from the u-turn, it is understood.

Some 1.9 million foreign nationals are set to be granted indefinite leave to remain by 2030 - an increase of 300,000 compared to November last year. Only 500,000 of them face a longer wait, according to estimates.

snippet.title: “전세기 타고 호화생활”…2조원 대 도박 사이트 일당 검거 / KBS 2026.11.03.
snippet.description:
해외에 거점을 두고 도박 자금만 2조 원이 넘는 도박 사이트를 운영한  일당이 붙잡혔습니다. 대학교수, 대기업 직원까지 영입한 이들은 범죄 수익금으로 전세기를 이용하는 등 해외에서 초호화 생활을 하다 덜미를 잡혔습니다. 양재희 기자입니다.

 [리포트]

 국내로 송환된 피의자들이 삼엄한 분위기 속에 경찰에 호송됩니다.

 말레이시아를 거점으로 도박 사이트를 운영한 조직원들입니다.

 불법 스포츠 토토와 바카라 등 9개 사이트를 오간 도박 자금만 2조 6천여억 원.

 해외와 국내에 총책을 따로 두고 자금 세탁과 차명 통장 알선 등 역할을 나눴습니다.

 특히, 수억 원대 연봉을 미끼로 대학교수와 플랫폼 기업 출신 등 전문 인력까지 영입했습니다.

 [오승수/충청북도경찰청 사이버수사2팀장 : "범죄단체를 기업화하려고 한 겁니다. 대기업 출신, 고학력자들이 (주간 실적을) 취합을 받아서 총책한테 보고하는."]

 최근 4년간 범죄 수익 추정액만  천 6백여억 원.

 한 총책은 전세기를 빌려 월드컵 관람을 가고 조직원들에게  고가 시계를 선물하는 등 호화 생활을 이어갔습니다.

 그런데 이런 사치스러운 행적이 이들의 발목을 잡았습니다.

 지난 4월 말레이시아 총책이 현지에서 납치됐다 경찰에 구조되면서 적색수배자란 사실이 드러난 겁니다.

 [김응성/충청북도경찰청 사이버수사대장 : "불상의 자에게 의해서 납치되어 몸값으로 150억 원을 요구받고 30억 원을 강취 당하는 사건이 발생하기도 하였습니다."]

 경찰은 국내 총책 등 87명을 검거해 18명을 구속하고, 6백여억 원에 대해 몰수와 추징보전을 신청했습니다.

 또 해외 총책 2명을 추가로 송환할 예정으로, 조직원 20여 명을 계속 쫓고 있습니다.

snippet.description:
태화강을 끼고 있는 울주군의 입암리 화석산지입니다.

물가 바위 표면에 규칙적으로 구멍들이 나타납니다.

그 구멍들 사이로 파인 기다란 선이 선명합니다.
